decisions.name: go-api-contracts
decisions.reason: The requested minor release changes the supported wire format and accepted field values. Preserve consumer-visible function signatures, Key fields, legacy simple keys, error sentinel, and zero failure results; test encode and decode independently from an external consumer package.

decisions.name: go-core-style
decisions.reason: This is Go implementation work. Use the standard library, explicit error guards, clear exported documentation, formatting, vet, and bounded tests. No abstractions or dependencies are needed.

decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
decisions.reason: Pure string codec change with no interface, dependency construction, options, wiring, or resource lifecycle change. Its skill was not opened.

decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
decisions.reason: The existing codec package retains its responsibility and location; no package split, merge, relocation, or ownership change. Its skill was not opened.
